hypothesis: The dark-mode sun/partly outline stroke was lifted all the way to near-white cream (#fff0c0); on the bright #f3c33d disc the rim washes out and the rays look faint, so the sun reads as a drafty blob.
notes: The two existing sun tests encoded the opposite hypothesis (stroke must be brighter/near-white than the disc fill). Confirmed red against #fff0c0, then fixed. New dark sun/partly line = #a86e18 (rgb 168,110,24).
